title: Payload: membership-accept/0.1 (rltp-membership@0.7, target Trust Tasks framework 0.4)
description: Payload schema per Trust Tasks 6.3 ($id = Type URI, describes only the payload). The consent artifact: subject MUST equal the document issuer AND the referenced invite's invitee (no transplantation); ref binds this accept to exactly one invite document by document digest; card is the subject's contact card, whose key-agreement key the welcome will be sealed to (card proof MUST verify and card.anchor MUST equal subject — a foreign card would redirect the group keys; retained per Contract section 5 from the accept's issuance; key transport, no freshness claimed). The document MUST carry a proof verifying under the issuer. One accept authorizes at most one admission (consumable at materialization). Normative rules in Membership Tasks 3.2, 3.3.

card.description: the subject's contact card (displayed form): carries the key-agreement key the welcome will be sealed to

multibaseMultihash.description: document digest of the invite being accepted (Contract section 2)
